# Boolean

Gives you one on/off switch to control several connected settings.

`lfs.boolean` · Input

## How to use

Use to switch several options together.\
Connect Value to a Boolean input; off is the default.

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value | `Value` | lfs.bool | false | — | Shared on/off value. Off, the default, means false or unselected; on means true or selected. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value | `Value` | lfs.bool | — | — | On for selected elements, off for unselected elements. Connect to a Selection or Boolean input. |
